April 22, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Mitsubishi Ufj Trust & Banking Corp increased its stake in Western Digital Corp (WDC) by 3.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mitsubishi Ufj Trust & Banking Corp bought 24,252 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 637,853 shares of the electronic components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.73M, up from 613,601 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mitsubishi Ufj Trust & Banking Corp who had been investing in Western Digital Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.65B market cap company. The stock increased 0.06% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $89.56. About 3.26 million shares traded. Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) has risen 17.32% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.77% the S&P500. 
Investec Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Investec Asset Management Ltd sold 4,471 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.11M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $188.20M, down from 1.12 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Investec Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $840.87 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26 million shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 15.29 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
